---
title: "Install and run"
---

## Requirements

- Python 3.8 or newer
- [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com/download) installed and logged in

There is nothing else to install.

## Get it

Download the repository as a [ZIP](https://github.com/GabeAlencar/fileshare/archive/refs/heads/main.zip),
or clone it:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/GabeAlencar/fileshare.git
```

## Start it

| OS      | Start it by                                                    |
|---------|----------------------------------------------------------------|
| Windows | double-click `FileShare.bat` (or `py fileshare.py`)            |
| macOS   | double-click `FileShare.command` (or `python3 fileshare.py`)   |
| Linux   | `./fileshare.sh` (or `python3 fileshare.py`)                   |

On macOS and Linux, stop it with Ctrl+C in the terminal. On Windows, end `pythonw`
or use the terminal version.

::: {.callout-note}
## Linux only, once

Receiving needs permission to talk to Tailscale without sudo:

```bash
sudo tailscale set --operator=$USER
```
:::

## Options

| Option            | What it does                                                  |
|-------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------|
| `--downloads DIR` | Save received files to `DIR` instead of `~/Downloads/FileShare` |
| `--port N`        | Serve the window on port `N` instead of a random one          |
| `--no-open`       | Don't open a window; just print the URL                       |
